# Licenses that go-licenses reports for a linked module but that cover none of
# the code linked into the binary, for dev/update_licenses.sh to leave out of the
# inventory. A compound license file is reported under every license it carries,
# including grants for parts of the module -- other languages, commands, tests --
# that never reach a Go binary. Drop those here rather than by editing the
# generated section of LICENSE-binary, which is overwritten on every run.
# Tab-separated:
#   <key>
# <key> is the module path for a module's own license file, or the module path
# joined with the directory the license governs for a nested one -- either way
# it reads like an import path. SKIP drops every license reported for the key.
# Every entry must match a license that is actually reported for a linked
# dependency. One that matches nothing fails the run rather than being ignored,
# so a typo surfaces immediately instead of leaving a correction silently not
# applied.
